changes_made.explanation: Added missing NLU tasks and datasets mentioned in the paper. The paper evaluates both generation (summarization, QA) and understanding tasks. Normalized dataset names for consistency.

The paper reports performance using average accuracy percentages but does not mention specific NLG evaluation metrics like BLEU, ROUGE, etc. The evaluation focuses on task performance metrics rather than NLG-specific automatic metrics.
No LLMs are used as evaluators/judges in this paper. The models mentioned (BERT, BLOOM, T5) are used as backbone models for parameter-efficient tuning experiments, not for evaluation.
The paper uses automatic evaluation metrics (accuracy percentages) and does not mention any human evaluation of the generated outputs.

overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on parameter-efficient tuning methods and their performance across different model scales. While it does involve NLG tasks (summarization, QA), the evaluation is based on task-specific performance metrics rather than traditional NLG evaluation approaches. The extraction was generally accurate but missed some NLU tasks that were also studied.
